sections.heading: Overview
sections.intent: State what the product is, the problem it solves and the one reason to choose it, in the customer's words

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.intent: List the features that matter to the buyer as benefit-led bullets, each tied to a concrete use

sections.heading: Who It Is For
sections.intent: Describe the buyer this product fits and the one it does not, and link to the parent category and the closest alternative

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.intent: Answer four purchase-blocking questions about compatibility, sizing, delivery and returns

spec.tone: Concrete and benefit-led; present tense; specific numbers over adjectives; no hype and no invented claims

shortDescription.intent: Say in plain words what the product is and the one reason to buy it, for a buyer reading beside the price

specifications.name: Form
specifications.intent: The form the product comes in, as its name or the page notes state it

specifications.name: Size
specifications.intent: The amount or the pack size, as the page notes state it
